about_pullquote: Every room we decorate gets the same care we'd give our own home.
about_para_1: Brush 2 Brush was founded on a simple idea: Bristol deserves decorators who actually care about the finish. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for reliability, attention to detail, and honest pricing. Our team knows Bristol inside out — from Victorian terraces in Clifton to modern apartments in the city centre.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we do what we promise: arrive on time, work cleanly, and deliver a finish you'll love. We don't cut corners on prep or use cheap materials, and we always clean up properly at the end of each day. That's why so many Bristol homeowners have us on speed dial for their next project.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Brush 2 Brush

reviews.text: Had the downstairs completely redecorated — walls, woodwork, the lot. The lads were tidy, professional, and genuinely nice to have around. Finished a day early too. Couldn't ask for better. Already booked them for the landing.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Got a free quote within 48 hours, no pressure, and the price was fair. Work was done in the timeframe promised. They sorted a small issue we spotted halfway through without any fuss. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Needed emergency redecoration before selling. Brush 2 Brush squeezed us in, worked quickly, and the finish was absolutely spot on. Buyers loved it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul K.
